question: Create a Kubernetes ServiceAccount YAML with automatic token mounting disabled.

ground_truth.answer:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: restricted-sa
  namespace: default
automountServiceAccountToken: false
context: io.k8s.api.core.v1.ServiceAccount: provides Pod identity; automountServiceAccountToken (boolean) controls whether a service account token is automatically projected into Pods using this ServiceAccount
